steps.name: ④ 실제 몬스터 이동 서비스로 언덕 접근 60걸음(카메라 배치 고정)
steps.do: var c=UnityEngine.Object.FindAnyObjectByType<GameSceneLifetimeScope>().Container; var model=(MonsterModel)c.Resolve(typeof(MonsterModel)); var grid=(TerrainHeightGrid)c.Resolve(typeof(TerrainHeightGrid)); var rules=(RunRulesData)c.Resolve(typeof(RunRulesData)); var service=(MonsterService)c.Resolve(typeof(MonsterService)); var before=new System.Collections.Generic.List<UnityEngine.Vector2>(); foreach(var m in model.MonsterList){before.Add(m.Position);} for(var tick=0;tick<60;tick++){service.TickMove(1f/30f);} var moved=0f; var climbed=0f; for(var i=0;i<before.Count;i++){var a=before[i]*rules.UnitScale; var b=model.MonsterList[i].Position*rules.UnitScale; moved=UnityEngine.Mathf.Max(moved,UnityEngine.Vector2.Distance(a,b)); climbed=UnityEngine.Mathf.Max(climbed,UnityEngine.Mathf.Abs(TerrainHeightMath.Sample(grid,a.x,a.y)-TerrainHeightMath.Sample(grid,b.x,b.y)));} System.IO.File.WriteAllText("output/hd2d-terrain/monster-slope-motion.json", Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConvert.SerializeObject(new { steps=60,seconds=2,monsterCount=model.MonsterList.Count,maxDisplacementMetres=moved,maxTerrainHeightChange=climbed }));
